findings.title: Output swap partial fill does not readjust pre-stored hook fees

confidence_deductions.reason: Partial attack path - requires colluding hook + SingleProvider pool
Requires specific pool configuration (output swap + partial fill + hook fee)

findings.description: In AMMModule._poolSwapByOutput, output-side hook fees are stored via _applySwapByOutputOutputFees BEFORE the pool type's swapByOutput is called. If the pool type returns a partial fill (actualAmountOut < originalAmountOut), the already-stored hook fees are not recalculated. The excess fees remain claimable by the hook owner from the pool's reserves.
findings.impact: Hook owner receives excess fees proportional to (hookFeePercent * (originalAmountOut - actualAmountOut)). For a 5% hook fee and 50% fill, 25 tokens excess per 1000 token swap.
findings.proof_sketch: Forge test AuditCrossBoundaryKLoopHyp.t.sol:test_H_R6_DP_03_partialFillHookFeeOrdering proves the ordering issue. SingleProviderHelper.sol:130-131 confirms partial fill path exists.
findings.victim: Liquidity providers in SingleProviderPoolType pools with token hooks
findings.extractable_value: hookFeePercent * (1 - fillRatio) * amountOut per partial-fill swap
attack_sequence: Deploy SingleProviderPoolType pool with limited reserves and a token hook charging output fees
Execute output-based swap with amountOut > reserves to trigger partial fill
Hook fees stored at full amountOut value, pool fills partially
Hook owner collects excess fees from pool reserves
code_smells: AMMModule.sol:1537 - hook fees stored BEFORE pool swap
AMMModule.sol:1577 - amountOut adjusted after swap but hook fees not recalculated
SingleProviderHelper.sol:130 - partial fill caps at reserves
findings.what_remains_unverified: Whether the colluding hook + pool setup is economically viable in practice given pool creation constraints

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct swap pricing bounds check uses pre-hook-fee amount (CB-002, H-R6-HH-05)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Existing guard: token creator controls both fees and bounds (FP pattern #4 - self-inflicted config). The bounds-fee interaction is by design. No third-party victim.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct swaps always revert on pricing bound violations - no healing tolerance (CB-003, H-R6-TS-02)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: No concrete attack path for value extraction. DoS-only with no profit mechanism. Token creator can update bounds. Self-inflicted config.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy during queued hook fee transfer via _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ENTERED bit preserved by TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags.sol:68-72. _setReentrancyFlags masks out ENTERED/NOT_ENTERED before ORing with current ENTERED state.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Hook fee key mismatch when tokenFor != tokenFee in _storeNonTokenHookFees
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Current code always calls _storeNonTokenHookFees with tokenFor==tokenFee. Keys match in all existing call paths. Latent design issue only if cross-token fees are added.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CLOB fill loop storage slot 0 collision when order book exhausted
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBHelper.sol:220-223 reverts with InsufficientInputToFill before reading from slot 0. The sentinel bucket has inputAmountRemaining=0.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: afterSwapRefund reentrancy into CLOB management functions
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMM ENTERED bit stays active during afterSwapRefund callback. CLOB management functions only affect caller's own state. No value extraction from other users.
When safeTransfer fails, _storeTokensOwed tracks the debt. AMM balance covers both reserves and tokensOwed. No solvency issue.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: setTokenSettings orphans hook fees (old hook can't collect)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Old hook CAN still call collectHookFeesByHook because storage key uses hook address and msg.sender check matches. Fees are accessible, not orphaned.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: collectFees hook drains provider via hookFee > accrued fees
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: maxHookFee guard at AMMModule.sol:338-340 protects provider. Requires provider to set maxHookFee=type(uint256).max AND use malicious token hook = self-inflicted config (FP pattern #4).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CLOB closeOrder nonce 0 in exhausted bucket
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: When nonce 0 order is added to exhausted bucket (currentOrderId=0), openOrder sets currentOrderId to thisOrderId. The bucket is no longer exhausted while nonce 0 has unfilled input.
Balance-before/after pattern at AMMModule.sol:2180-2210 catches any mismatch. Handler MUST deliver correct tokenIn or TX reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Hook fee manipulation - hook returns fee > swap amount
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Guard at AMMModule.sol:2616: if (feeAmount > swapAmountIn) revert LBAMM__InsufficientInputForFees(). Max hook fee = swap amount.
AMM ENTERED bit remains active during entire swap. Token callback cannot re-enter AMM. TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags.sol:80 reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Bunni-pattern hook/pool accounting desync via revert
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule._executeSwapHook does NOT use try/catch. Hook reverts propagate to entire TX rollback. No partial state persistence.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient storage cross-path read between swap and liquidity operations
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT only used in _validatePricingBounds (beforeSwap write, afterSwap read). No other code path reads this slot.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Diamond storage slot collision across facets
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hooks, pool types, and handlers are separate contracts (not diamond facets). Diamond storage at 0x9A1D. No overlap with DIAMOND_STORAGE_QUEUED_FEE_COLLECT.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Pool type return value trust - amountOut > original
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Guard at AMMModule.sol:1559: if (actualAmountOut > originalAmountOut) revert. Guard at AMMModule.sol:1399: if (actualAmountIn > originalAmountIn) revert.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct swap pricing bounds self-inflicted config (H-R6-TS-01)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Token creator sets both fee BPS and pricing bounds. Any under-enforcement is self-inflicted config error (FP pattern #4).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CLOB closeOrder price update skip at non-current price level
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: By design: closing non-current order removes from linked list, nextPriceAbove correctly skips removed level. Cursor advances correctly.

theft_theses.thesis: Extract value via partial fill hook fee overcrediting in output swaps
Bypass pricing bounds via pre-fee amount discrepancy in direct swaps
theft_theses.victim: Token holders relying on max price bounds
theft_theses.asset: Favorable swap terms beyond intended bounds

theft_theses.thesis: Drain LP via collectFees hook returning hookFee > accrued fees
Extract value via reentrancy during queued hook fee transfer
Orphan hook fees by changing token hook address
DoS direct swaps via pricing bound violations

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If an attacker triggers _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) during fee distribution, all flags including ENTERED would be cleared, allowing re-entry into the AMM during the callback.
hypothesis_results.detail: ENTERED bit preserved by bitwise masking. _setReentrancyFlags strips ENTERED/NOT_ENTERED from input flags, then ORs with current ENTERED state. Guard holds.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If _storeNonTokenHookFees receives cross-token fees (tokenFor != tokenFee), the storage key hash(hook, hash(tokenFor, tokenFor)) would differ from collection key hash(hook, hash(tokenFor, tokenFee)), orphaning fees.
hypothesis_results.detail: All current call sites pass same-token fees. Keys match. Latent issue only if cross-token hook fees are added in future.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If hook fees are stored before the pool swap and the pool returns a partial fill, the hook receives fees proportional to the original amount while only a fraction of the trade executed.
hypothesis_results.guard_location: AMMModule.sol:1559 (partial fill detection exists but no fee adjustment)
hypothesis_results.detail: LEAD: Math proof shows 25 token excess on 500/1000 fill with 5% fee. Requires SingleProviderPoolType + output swap + token hook fees. Needs integration PoC for confirmation.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If a malicious token hook returns hookFee > fees accrued and provider set maxHookFee=type(uint256).max, the provider must send tokens INTO the AMM during collectFees.
hypothesis_results.detail: maxHookFee guard protects provider. Requires provider to set maxHookFee=max AND use malicious hook = self-inflicted config.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If an attacker pushes pool price outside bounds, all direct swaps for that token pair always revert because poolType==address(0) makes both min and max bound checks unconditional.
hypothesis_results.detail: CONFIRMED informational: Direct swaps have no healing tolerance. DoS on direct swap pathway when price outside bounds. Token creator can update bounds.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If beforeSwap stores pre-hook-fee amountIn and afterSwap computes price using that stored value, the bounds check uses a systematically lower price than the actual trade. At 50% fee, actual price is 2x the checked price.
hypothesis_results.detail: LEAD: Math proof shows 2x discrepancy at 50% fee. Token creator controls both fee and bounds (FP pattern #4), but counterparty gets favorable terms.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If order book is exhausted and traverseCLOB reads _orderIdToOrder(bytes32(0)), it accesses storage slot 0 which overlaps with nextOrderNonce, corrupting CLOB state.
hypothesis_results.detail: Reverts with InsufficientInputToFill before reading slot 0. Sentinel bucket has inputAmountRemaining=0.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If nonce 0 order exists in an exhausted bucket (currentOrderId=bytes32(0)), closeOrder reads ptrCurrentOrder.orderNonce from slot 1 = 0. Since 0 > 0 is false, the order wrongly reverts.
hypothesis_results.detail: When nonce 0 is added to exhausted bucket, openOrder sets currentOrderId=thisOrderId. Bucket not exhausted while nonce 0 has unfilled input.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If executor reenters CLOB during afterSwapRefund ETH callback, they could withdraw maker token balance while also receiving the refund, double-counting funds.
hypothesis_results.detail: AMM guard active. CLOB ops only affect caller's own state. Maker balance credits go to makers, not executor. No double-counting.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If addLiquidity's distribution transfer fails, reserves are incremented but tokens stay in AMM. The reserve-to-balance ratio is inflated, potentially allowing over-withdrawal.
hypothesis_results.detail: tokensOwed tracks the debt. AMM balance covers both reserves and owed. Accounting is consistent. No solvency risk.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If token admin changes hook from A to B, hook A's accumulated fees become orphaned because collectHookFeesByHook checks msg.sender == hook and hook A is no longer the active hook.
hypothesis_results.detail: Old hook CAN still call collectHookFeesByHook. Storage key uses hook address, msg.sender check matches. Fees are technically accessible.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If direct swap pricing bounds include hook fees in the denominator, the effective price check is looser than intended, allowing swaps above max bound.
hypothesis_results.detail: Token creator controls both fees and bounds. Same root cause as H-R6-HH-05. Self-inflicted configuration.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If output-based direct swap stores pre-output-fee amountOut in tstore, the pricing check uses inflated amountOut, making bounds check systematically looser.
hypothesis_results.detail: Same root cause as H-R6-HH-05. Output direction has same discrepancy. Self-inflicted config.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If orders are closed in non-lowest-first order, the CLOB price cursor could skip valid price levels, leaving orders unfillable at those prices.
hypothesis_results.detail: Closing non-current order updates nextPriceAbove correctly. Cursor advances to next valid price. No orders skipped.

hypothesis_results.refutation_case: If executor reenters CLOB via afterSwapRefund ETH callback, they could manipulate order book state to extract value from concurrent transactions.
hypothesis_results.detail: Same analysis as H-R6-HH-10. AMM guard active, CLOB ops only affect own state. No value extraction from others.
